description: What the loaded library held under the eighteen canonical summon parents, listed by the test-only loader harness (kmgVariantCensus), which does not use the product's observers. A choice written as a bare identity is a project identity whose internal name was checked against its manifest symbol; any other choice is [identity, internal name].

provenance.game: Pathfinder: Kingmaker 2.1.7b, disposable copy, Unity Mod Manager 0.33.0
